acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-tasks ticket show <id>` renders the ticket's dependencies array (ticketId, obligation, gateId) in its items, matching what `set-dependencies` wrote.
A test covers a ticket with two dependencies read back through ticket show.
body: Source: V1-1262 lane, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.456. Repro: `corvint-tasks ticket show ticket:corvint:main:V1-1266` after `set-dependencies` recorded V1-1263..1265 as COMPLETED obligations. Expected: the dependencies appear in the show output. Actual: the output lists blockers derived from the dependencies (DEPENDENCY_UNSATISFIED) but not the dependencies themselves, so an agent cannot audit the recorded edges without a search over the queue export.
title: corvint-tasks: ticket show omits the recorded dependencies array
